basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old from Austin, Texas, trying to navigate life post-college. I recently graduated with a degree in Computer Science and am currently working as a junior developer at a small startup. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time exploring new tech gadgets, playing video games, and learning how to play the guitar. I'm still trying to figure out adulting, and Reddit has become a go-to place for advice and community support. I usually browse Reddit during my lunch breaks and late at night when everything is quiet.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a foundational understanding of computer science from my undergraduate degree, and I'm continuously learning through online courses and tutorials. My work as a junior developer involves a lot of hands-on coding, which is helping me gain practical experience.
